title: Plato Dialogues: Lysis, Symposium, Phaedrus - Easton Press
descriptionText:
This rare collector's edition of Plato's Dialogues, including the Lysis or Friendship Symposium and Phaedrus, is a must-have for any philosophy or friendship enthusiast. The beautiful leather binding and original text make this book a valuable addition to any collection.

With its North American region and English language, this book is a unique find for those interested in Plato's works. The publisher, Easton Press, is well-known for its high-quality publications, making this book a reliable addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this original copy of Plato's Dialogues.
